description: §22.12 (S459 round 4 F3) — a `template` inside SVG has no content fragment; the gate walks it as an ordinary element (it used to throw `Illegal invocation` out of `meta.emit`). Admitted.
rationale: §22.12 step 2: a `template` element in SVG or MathML is an ordinary element whose children are judged; a throwing read is a violation, never an exception. (S459 round 4, PA decisions on the S459 final review — bryan "go")
